title: Amazon Web Services IAM user access key: must be flagged (provider-documented)
summary: Synthetic Amazon Web Services IAM user access key values built to the documented format appear in 2 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: AKIA ID and separate 40-character secret together. Both secret components are expected; composite scanner output is mapped without consulting expected ranges. ASIA/session credentials are not covered.
